cc:Work.dc:title: Box - MatrixStand
cc:Work.dc:description:
Matrix base composed of two Console2 ends and a central box
This generator combines two Console2-style ends with a simplified middle box. The sides and bottom are generated as single pieces across all three sections.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes MatrixStand Command line short: boxes MatrixStand
